params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; function Probe([string]$u){ $sw=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $u -TimeoutSec 10; $sw.Stop(); [ordered]@{url=$u;ok=($r.StatusCode -eq 200);status=[int]$r.StatusCode;elapsed_ms=$sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;body=$r.Content.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(800,$r.Content.Length))} } catch { $sw.Stop(); [ordered]@{url=$u;ok=$false;elapsed_ms=$sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;error=$_.Exception.Message} } }; $a=Probe 'http://127.0.0.1:7331/api/status'; $b=Probe 'http://127.0.0.1:7443/api/status'; [ordered]@{direct=$a;proxy=$b} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; if(-not $a.ok -or -not $b.ok){ exit 2 }
